method: Assistant inspected all 192 decoded frames in eight ordered contact sheets and five full decoded boards; not real-time playback or artist approval.
observations: Each segment shows the base image translated as a whole; the added reflection moves in the opposite direction. Original photographed catchlights remain in both conditions.
Base-only controls are on the left, contaminated sequences on the right; anchor 0 is above anchor 12. Query frames are explicitly unscored. RAFT has no interpolated track between scored frames.
At left_0_y frame 0, the contaminated anchor-12 CoTracker prediction is accepted despite lying above the known material point; displayed EPE is 3.13 px. It is not at the synthetic reflection centre.
At right_3_y frame 23, the contaminated anchor-12 CoTracker prediction is far from material truth and is rejected; displayed EPE is 11.15 px.
At left_0_x frame 12, RAFT remains near the known material point under the addition. This is whole-image synthetic motion evidence, not demonstrated real iris rotation or clean-radiance recovery.
